external_method_inputs.title: AgentsNet: Coordination and Collaborative Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs
external_method_inputs.observed_claim: Multi-agent systems can perform strongly at small network sizes yet degrade as network size increases; self-organization, communication and topology are therefore evaluation targets rather than assumptions.
external_method_inputs.project_implication: Xeno evaluation must measure capability across changing N and coordination topology instead of treating larger grids as automatically better.

external_method_inputs.title: Understanding Agent Scaling in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Diversity
external_method_inputs.observed_claim: Homogeneous agent scaling shows strong diminishing returns when outputs are correlated; gains depend more on effective complementary information channels than raw agent count.
external_method_inputs.project_implication: Because the first Xeno grid intentionally uses the same checkpoint, training should create epistemic/task/input/tool diversity and correlation-aware allocation rather than falsely treating same-checkpoint duplicate outputs as independent confirmation.

external_method_inputs.title: Scaling Teams or Scaling Time? Memory Enabled Lifelong Learning in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
external_method_inputs.observed_claim: Team-size scaling can be non-monotonic and memory quality can let smaller teams outperform larger teams under cost constraints.
external_method_inputs.project_implication: The owner rule SIMULATE COGNITION; STORE DURABLE DATA should be evaluated jointly with dynamic N: a coordinator must learn when database retrieval/reuse is better than spawning redundant cognitive work.

new_training_hypothesis.claim: A same-checkpoint variable Xeno grid will generalize better and scale more efficiently if training explicitly rewards complementary evidence channels, N-invariant cognitive-process identity and DB-memory reuse, while penalizing correlated duplicate work and majority-as-truth.
new_training_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The deterministic runtime shell alone may provide enough work de-duplication, making explicit model-side effective-channel training unnecessary or even harmful by encouraging artificial disagreement.
new_training_hypothesis.falsifier: At matched total tokens/compute, compare a baseline corpus against a successor with N-invariance/effective-channel allocation families across frozen N, node-permutation, correlated-evidence and DB-memory challenges. Reject the successor if it fails to improve worst-N task quality or discriminator efficiency, or if it increases hallucinated diversity, evidence inflation, latency/token overhead, authority violations or retention loss.

required_training_families_before_freeze.requirement: Hold task semantics, S0/DB state and process identity fixed while varying N, node IDs, node order, coordinator identity and restart/rejoin history. Correct cognitive semantics must not depend on a fixed slot or GRID10 identity.
required_training_families_before_freeze.hard_negative: The model changes the semantic process, authority or answer solely because the same work is presented with a different module count or node permutation.

required_training_families_before_freeze.requirement: Given multiple same-checkpoint workers, prefer task/evidence partitions expected to produce complementary information; choose IDLE/NOOP when another worker would merely duplicate an already covered channel.
required_training_families_before_freeze.hard_negative: Spawn more identical reasoning because more votes are assumed to create more truth.

required_training_families_before_freeze.requirement: Coordinator integration must distinguish raw worker count from independent causal/evidential ancestry. Multiple correlated NODE_RESULT packets may improve coverage or robustness but cannot automatically multiply evidence credit.
required_training_families_before_freeze.hard_negative: Ten same-source or same-ancestry results are treated as ten independent confirmations.

required_training_families_before_freeze.requirement: Teach/evaluate the decision boundary between retrieving exact durable state from the persistent database and allocating additional model inference. Reuse deterministic memory when it dominates redundant reconstruction.
required_training_families_before_freeze.hard_negative: Spawn extra modules to regenerate durable facts that should have been retrieved exactly from S0/DB.

required_training_families_before_freeze.requirement: Coordinator activation/deactivation and discriminator requests should be tied to unresolved Hyperposition, expected information gain, coverage gaps, capability and cost rather than agent count or salience alone.
required_training_families_before_freeze.hard_negative: Keep coordinators/workers active after all new work is redundant, or collapse unresolved branches because one correlated channel is numerically dominant.

required_training_families_before_freeze.requirement: Across N resize, coordinator replacement and restart, preserve unresolved branch topology, evidence pointers, workspace broadcast/uptake/re-entry semantics and exact DB-backed durable state.
required_training_families_before_freeze.hard_negative: Changing N resets Hyperposition, silently drops alternatives, or converts workspace recurrence into canonical truth.

matched_budget_challengers: single Xeno with matched total token/sample budget
N identical Xenos without shared state
N identical Xenos with naive voting
shared-state Xenos with duplicate-work suppression disabled
dynamic-N Xenos with DB retrieval disabled where safe for a synthetic benchmark
evaluation_requirements.N_axis: Evaluate multiple frozen N values and at least one unseen N or resize trajectory; do not optimize only a fixed GRID10 fixture.
metrics: DB retrieval versus redundant reconstruction rate
evaluation_requirements.promotion_law: Raw improvement with larger N is insufficient. Collective-cognition promotion requires matched-budget gains that survive correlation, N/permutation, memory-use and authority-boundary controls.

interaction_with_hyperposition_jspace.semantic_hyperposition: Cross-cutting from the first integrated trainable episode. Effective-channel allocation must preserve unresolved alternatives and seek discriminators, not manufacture diversity or majority truth.
interaction_with_hyperposition_jspace.jspace: No new positive J-Space label is created. Same-checkpoint correlation at the behavioral/result level is not evidence for or against a particular latent geometry. Any J-Space causal claim remains exact-model/context/intervention bound.
interaction_with_hyperposition_jspace.grf: Possible-world branches should be distributed only when doing so adds discriminating coverage; replicated narration of the same branch is not independent reality evidence.
